files.speaker: ruby
files.text: You found the Heart Seed and became a person again! I’m Ruby.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Empress is beaten and Mint is free! Grandma’s recipes are down these pipes.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: So hot! This machine burns stolen flavor. Cocoa is free now!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The frozen mochi here were people once. Taro is free!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A Crown root drinks this kitchen. Yuzu is here — let’s cut it!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The root slid into the garden. Grandma’s flavor is still in the Crown.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: These spores eat memories. Stay close to me!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The bees once made honey for everyone. Now they guard it for the Hunger.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Time stopped here when the curse began.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: All the roots lead to one place. The Hunger is growing a body.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The fields are empty. The Hunger is reaching for the First Tree.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: These flowers were eaten hollow. Stay sharp!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The glass shows the old kingdom. Look — people, not mochi!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The first seeds sleep here. The First Tree is close!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: This is the First Tree. Thank you for bringing me this far.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Long ago, a Crown turned everyone in Mochitopia into mochi — and began eating their flavor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: I’m Ruby, a jam spirit. Grandma made me to guard her recipe book and one sleeping seed.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Today the floor cracked, you fell, and the Heart Seed woke in your hands. You’re a person again!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Empress is free and her flavor came home. These pipes lead to where Grandma hid her jar.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Before the Hunger caught her, Grandma dropped her jar into the cracks to keep it safe.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Inside: Grandma’s Battle Recipes! Three seed styles for your Heart Seed; choose one on each floor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: This furnace burns the flavor the Hunger steals. Every spark is a piece of someone.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Look at those jars. Cursed mochi are trapped inside, drained of everything they are.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Stop the furnace and their flavor comes home — then your seed can break their curse!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Cursed mochi are frozen in here as fuel. Their voices tremble beneath the frost.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: That gentle voice… Grandma! She froze herself so the Hunger could not eat her last page.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Her flavor is locked inside the Crown itself. We free the others now — then we go get hers.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Crown Oven. A root of the Crown comes up here to drink the whole kitchen’s flavor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: I’m frightened. But Grandma is waiting, and the First Tree is starving.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Let’s cut this root together. Then we follow it — all the way to the Crown.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Stay alive until the timer ends. Keep moving!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Beat monsters to fill the Meter!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Keep the Wisp safe. Outside, you bleed!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Stand inside the ring!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Protect the flower! Stay close.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Grab petals for all 4 seasons!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Stand next to each root anchor to snap it!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Stay in the moving clean-air ring!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Dash into the glowing item to kick it at the boss!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A Miniboss! Beat it to spin the reward wheel!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Boss! Dash away from red warnings, then hit back!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A Magnet! It pulls in all your EXP.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A Heal Mochi! Grab it to get HP back.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A Treasure Chest! Open it for a free upgrade.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Depths is open! Use shovels to dig under the temple. Find the ladder to go deeper.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Rewards is open! Your daily login gift, Daily Quests and Awards are all here.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Bazaar is open! Open treasure chests and shop for gear with your Sugar and Thread.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Activities: daily goals and side fun that pay out rewards.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Daily Quests reset every day — finish them for reward boxes!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Awards count your big moments and pay Sugar for each one.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: News shows what changed in each update.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Mail keeps loot that did not fit your bag. Check it often!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Equipment! Put on the gear you find — it lives in the Upgrade tab.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Affix Forge lets you reroll the powers on your gear (Upgrade tab).

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Heroes! A new friend has joined — switch heroes and spend Talent points here.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Recipe Book remembers every Build card, relic and monster you meet.

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Poke me again. I dare you!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Pew pew! Did you see that?

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Let’s go! My feet are bouncy!

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Chill. I’ve got your back.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Too hot? I can fix that.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Brr! …That was me. Sorry.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Cookie? I always carry two.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Hide behind me, little one.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Big hug or big punch? Pick!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Zap! …Mostly on purpose.

files.speaker: taro
files.text: My compass says: adventure!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Ooh, sparkly! Can I touch it?

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Yuzlings! Look busy!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Tiny crew, big trouble!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Citrus squad, roll out!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: If I stop obeying, who will keep my children safe?

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: No! The crystal promised they would be safe!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Workers, stay behind me!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: The orders are quiet… please, keep the eggs warm.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: You call it waste. I can still hear their names.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: I will not let another memory wash away!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: The pipes are full. There is nowhere left to keep them!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: The water is clear… I can hear each voice again.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: The stove must stay lit. Someone is still waiting for dinner.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Just one more tray. Then everyone can eat.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Why does every meal smell like smoke?

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: At last… I can let the stove cool.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: If the ice melts, what will protect them from forgetting?

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Stay frozen. Stay safe. That was the order.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Do not take the last shelter I can give them!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Their voices… they are warmer than I remember.

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: A kingdom that cannot remember hunger can never complain.

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: Give me the taste you are trying to save.

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: You cannot empty a hunger by feeding it!

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: You have cut one root. I have so many more.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Mother said I would bloom forever if I brought enough flavor.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Do not let my petals fall before she sees me!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Every spore carries a memory. I need them all!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Mother… was any of this garden ever mine?

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: One heart cannot bear to lose another voice.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Stay together. No one leaves the colony!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Breathe with us. Forget the world outside!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: So many names… they can finally go home.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: My workers brought this home. It has to be enough.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Every drop belongs in the royal stores!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Do not show my workers an empty flower!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: The honey… we were feeding them the curse.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: One more moment. I can still save this day.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Spring will mend it. Winter will keep it. Again!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: If the hands stop, nothing else has to change!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Tomorrow… I had forgotten there could be a tomorrow.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: I kept every voice alive. Why do they all ask to leave?

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: My roots have held this kingdom for centuries!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Do not ask a mother to loosen her hold!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: The one who planted me… he is still waiting.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: There must be one more row. Someone is still hungry.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: The granaries cannot be empty. I harvested everything!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Stand back. I have not finished the last row!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: The fields were green once… plant something for them.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: If I take just one more taste, perhaps I will feel it.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: I remember sweetness. Why can I not taste yours?

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Do not leave me empty again!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: So quiet… I can finally hear the orchard breathe.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Outside, everything breaks. Here, I can still keep them whole.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: That reflection is the kingdom before we failed it!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: I will not let another future shatter!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Let them grow in the sun… even if the glass cannot follow.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: I know that seed. One has been missing all this time.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: A closed vault cannot make another mistake!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: If one seed changed everything, what might another do?

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Then take them… plant them well. Do not keep them as I did.

files.speaker: planter
files.text: I wanted no one to go hungry. Tell me that was not wrong.

files.speaker: planter
files.text: I did it to feed the world! Why did their faces disappear?

files.speaker: planter
files.text: If I take it off, who will keep them safe from hunger?

files.speaker: planter
files.text: Every flavor… every person. I remember why I planted it now.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Long ago, Mochitopia was a kingdom of people — and every home was full of flavor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The First Planter set a Crown on the First Tree… and the Crown grew hungry.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: In one night, everyone became mochi — and the Crown began to eat their flavor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Hundreds of years later, a little strawberry mochi is tidying a quiet pantry…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: …when the starving Hunger’s roots burst up through the floor!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: …and a little strawberry mochi falls into the dark!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: She lands with a thump in a sour ant nest. Something pale is moving in the dark…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Blank, flavorless mochi creep closer — toward a little jam spirit hiding behind a crystal.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: “This way!” squeaks Ruby. The two of them dash between the old roots.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: There, among the roots, something tiny is glowing — a sleeping seed.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Heart Seed wakes at her touch…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: …and the curse breaks. Strawberry is a person again!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: “I’m Ruby, Grandma’s jam spirit! That seed can free everyone. Let’s go!”

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Ready, Ruby? Let’s go!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: One step at a time!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Taste this!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Full flavor, coming through!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Getting the hang of it!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: A little stronger!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Now we’re cooking!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Let’s try this!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Whoa. That’s a big one.

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: We can do this together!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Ouch! Need a moment.

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Still on my feet!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Back for another helping!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: I’m not done yet!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: We did it, Ruby!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Flavor saved!

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Stay close.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Let’s keep this cool.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Winter, answer me.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Freeze.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: That should help.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: A little sharper.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Colder. Better.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Now it’s ready.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: I’ll slow it down.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Keep your distance.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: I’m still standing.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: That was close.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Not cold enough yet.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: I’m back. Focus.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Everyone safe? Good.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: That will do.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: All right. I’m up.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Let’s get moving.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Big punch coming!

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Here comes the heavy bit!

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Feeling stronger.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: That woke me up.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Now we’re talking!

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: These fists are ready.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: That one’s big. Good.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: I’ll take the front.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Ow. Careful now.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Still got a little fight.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Not done yet!

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Back on my feet.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Nap time. Earned it.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Anyone bring cookies?

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Adventure this way!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: I know a shortcut. Maybe.

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Storm, this way!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Let’s light it up!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: That’s a good discovery!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: New route unlocked!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Now that’s electric!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: A brilliant connection!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Big trouble ahead!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: I’ve got a plan! Sort of.

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Oh. That hurt.

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Time to rethink the route!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Back on the map!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: I’m not lost yet!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: We found our way!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: I meant to do that!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Citrus squad, with me!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: All accounted for? Move out!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Together, now!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Squad, show them!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Good work, team!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Room to grow!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Squad, new formation!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Look how you’ve grown!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Team, focus that one!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Big target! Stay together!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Hold the line, crew!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: I need a little cover!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Back in command!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: The squad’s not done!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: That’s my wonderful squad!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Everyone gets an orange!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: My eggs… where are they?

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Please, leave the little ones alone.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Those voices… I remember them.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Please, let the water flow.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Someone is waiting for a warm meal.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: I only wanted to feed them.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Were they cold all this time?

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: I wanted to keep them safe.

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: So hungry… why am I hungry?

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: The root is pulling me apart.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Mother… can you hear me?

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: I wanted a garden of my own.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: These voices… they have names.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: I can’t hold them all.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: My hive… did they have enough?

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: That honey tastes wrong.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Was there another season?

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: I’m afraid to let today go.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: The garden… it is so heavy.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: There is someone beneath the roots.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: These fields need time to rest.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Did anything survive the harvest?

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Was the orchard always so quiet?

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: I remember something sweet.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Can they grow beyond the glass?

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: I only wanted to keep them safe.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Seeds need soil, don’t they?

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: What good is a seed that never grows?

files.speaker: planter
files.text: I wanted everyone to have enough.

files.speaker: planter
files.text: When did my wish become this?

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Chill. I’ve got your back.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Free at last. Can I nap now?

files.speaker: taro
files.text: I’m free! Which way is adventure?

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Citrus squad, ready to grow?

files.text: Stop the furnace and their flavor comes home — then your seed can break their curse!

files.text: Her flavor is locked inside the Crown itself. We free the others now — then we go get hers.

files.text: Let’s cut this root together. Then we follow it — all the way to the Crown.

files.text: A cursed friend is trapped here, drained of flavor…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Heart Seed glows in Strawberry’s hands.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The curse breaks!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Mint, the village healer, is a person again — and her frost can freeze the sour drains!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A cursed friend is trapped here, drained of flavor…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Heart Seed glows in Strawberry’s hands.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The curse breaks!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Cocoa, the old gate guard, is back — ready to punch through the iron machines!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A cursed friend is trapped here, drained of flavor…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Heart Seed glows in Strawberry’s hands.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The curse breaks!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Taro, the kingdom’s mapmaker, is free — his lightning leaps from guard to guard!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A cursed friend is trapped here, drained of flavor…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Heart Seed glows in Strawberry’s hands.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The curse breaks!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Yuzu, the orange grower, is herself again — with her little Yuzling close by!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Crown Oven goes cold. The wounded root tears itself free…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: …and burrows down through the earth, toward the garden below.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The wounded root fled into the Fermented Canopy…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: …and there it grows the Hunger a new body from stolen memories.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Root Throne falls. Freed memories drift home like tiny lights.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Heart Seed blazes and points the way — toward the First Tree.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Beyond the garden, the fields are grey. Every flavor here is already gone.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: On the far hill stands the First Tree, black roots climbing its trunk. The Hunger is almost there.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Broken mirrors hold the kingdom’s memories — people laughing, before the Crown.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: One mirror shows a pink-haired girl with her family. Strawberry remembers.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The First Planter kneels and lifts the Crown from the First Tree.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Crown cracks apart!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Strawberry plants the Heart Seed at the roots.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A new tree grows, and the stolen flavor rushes back to every home.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: One by one, the people of Mochitopia become themselves again.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Grandma is free. Ruby hugs her and will not let go.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Deep below, the Hunger curls up and falls asleep… for now.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: In the dark beneath Mochitopia, the Hunger opens one eye.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The way down is open. Together, the friends step into the Delve.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Empress once bargained with the Crown to keep her eggs alive.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The crystal saved the nursery — then ordered even its youngest workers into battle.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Clogmaw kept the scraps and forgotten flavors that washed into the drains.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Crown twisted his care into hoarding, until no water or memory could escape.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Mr. Griddle once kept the royal kitchen warm for everyone.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Crown made him burn stolen memories. He forgot every recipe except: keep the fire alive.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Golem believed that people frozen in his prison would be safe from the Hunger.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: But the ice could not stop their names from fading. Grandma’s cure still lay beyond it, inside the Crown.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: This creature was only the mouth of one root beneath the Crown Oven.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: It grew from a wish to end hunger, then learned to feed on the kingdom’s flavor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The wounded root grew a daughter from flavors stolen from the garden.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Bud gathered more memories, hoping her mother would finally call her a real flower.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Behemoth held the marsh’s memories together inside one great fungal body.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Every stranger felt like a wound. Poison became the only protection the colony remembered.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Hornet Queen once shared her hive’s nectar with the whole garden.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Crown spoiled the royal stores. Too proud to admit it, she fed her workers the curse.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: When the curse began, the Orchid stopped time to save one perfect bloom.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Centuries passed outside. Inside, all four seasons struggled through the same unfinished day.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The garden’s stolen flavors gathered inside the Hunger’s new heart.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Rootmother called them her children — and would not let a single memory go home.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Colossus had sworn to leave no field ungathered while anyone was hungry.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Even after the Crown took every crop, he kept harvesting ash rather than break his oath.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: She had been the orchard’s last flower before the Crown stole her sweetness.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: She tried filling that empty place with other flavors. Every stolen taste made it larger.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Gardener hid the old kingdom’s memories inside living glass.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: He cut away every future that might hurt them — including the path that could set them free.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: For centuries, the Seedwarden counted seeds that had never touched soil.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A new seed might repeat the curse. A locked vault felt safer than choosing hope.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The First Planter crowned the First Tree because he feared another famine.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: He called the Crown salvation. Defeat finally made him face what his wish had cost.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: You will not win, mochi!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Clogged forever!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: The stove never sleeps!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: You will freeze solid!

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: Feed me more!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Breathe it in!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: The swamp is alive!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Bzzz!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Time is up for you!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: My roots run deep!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: My scythe is hungry!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Nothing tastes good!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Look, but do not touch!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Give up, mochi!

files.speaker: planter
files.text: Why do you fight me?
